security.heading: What the policies are
security.body: Friction, not a security boundary. A policy makes a risky action refused, asked about, warned on or flagged — not impossible. Advisory text can be ignored, and a block on the shell can be sidestepped by a determined agent. Each label says exactly how far a policy goes.

security.heading: What the site does
security.body: The site is static files: nothing you pick leaves your machine, and the builder runs in your browser. Your selection lives in the URL fragment after the #, which browsers never send to a server. There is no analytics, no cookie, no account.

security.heading: Why the command is safe to read before running
security.body: The command fetches one pinned catalog commit and checks every policy against its sha256 — the same hash shown on the policy's page. If the pack does not match, the install fails and nothing is written.

security.heading: How to report a problem
security.body: Report it as a security issue in the chock-catalog repository, not as a public issue in the engine or the site.

install.install_note: Python 3.12 or newer. The engine is the only install; the plugin is generated from the pinned catalog.
install.run_body: Pick your policies on the builder, copy the command and run it in your repo. --apply writes the plugin under .claude; without it, chock only prints the two claude plugin commands that install it.
install.update_body: Change your picks in the builder and re-run the command, then restart the session or run /reload-plugins.
install.file_body: A selection is a small JSON or YAML file naming the client, the pinned catalog commit and the policies you picked. The builder writes one for you; the install command reads the same file. These are the fields it checks:

file_fields.meaning: claude-code — the agent the plugin is built for.
the pinned catalog commit; the plugin builds only from it.
optional — a named catalog release over the commit.
optional — the preset the picks started from.
one entry per picked policy: id, version and sha256.

clients_intro: chock.sh builds for Claude Code. For other agents, install policies from their marketplace repos:

warning_texts.missing_partner: __PRESENT__ is picked without __ABSENT__: the two cover one rule by different means; pick both.
warning_texts.all_present: __PRESENT__ are all picked and overlap: keep one, or the same action is checked twice.
warning_texts.file_absent: __PRESENT__ refuses everything until your repo has __FILE__. Create it before you install.
warning_texts.grade:warn: __PRESENT__ only warns while it is measured: nothing is refused.
warning_texts.grade:advise: __PRESENT__ is text only: nothing stops a violation.
